findings.evidence: _words() splits only on case changes, letter/digit changes and _-.:/, and _SENSITIVE_WORDS requires \b around otp/cvv/pin/password, so a lowercase run-together name never matches (only [a-z]*otp at the END of a word is handled). field_is_sensitive({'type':'text','name':n,'value':'482913'}) is False for otpcode, smsotpcode, otpvalue, otpnumber, cvvcode, cvvnumber, cardcvv, cardcvc, userpassword, newpassword, confirmpassword, loginpassword, txnpassword, upipin, atmpin, cardpin, securitypin, loginpwd, userpass, verifycode. Real Chromium (run_snapshot.cjs + snapshot.js) on <input name=otpcode value=482913>, <input name=cvvcode value=123>, <input name=newpassword type=text value=Hunter2Secret!>, <input name=upipin value=4321> returned sensitive:false with all four values. AssistCommands.assist_ask with a fake browser adapter put all four values into the stream_chat body (probe /tmp/uri_review_R2/probe_brain.py). popup.html promises one-time codes are removed in the page; A0_QUALIFICATION marks A0-AC7 MET.
findings.suggested_fix: In both layers also match sensitive stems as substrings of a run-together token, with an explicit list of harmless words to skip (e.g. (otp|cvv|cvc|ccv|password|passwd|passcode|pwd|mpin|tpin|upipin|atmpin) anywhere, 'pin' only as a suffix of a known prefix), keeping pincode/spinner/hotpot readable; add these names to tricky_fields.html and the Python/JS parity test.
findings.title: Redaction still misses lowercase run-together OTP/CVV/PIN/password field names (R1-02 class not closed), in both Python and in-page JS

findings.evidence: numbers('Rs 2 000 000') == numbers('Rs 2 000') == {'2','000'} (also with U+202F grouping). verify('...onions now cost Rs 2 000 000 per kilogram this week [1].', ['...onions now cost Rs 2 000.']) keeps the claim; find_conflicts reports 0 conflicts for the pair. Number words ('five hundred' vs 'nine hundred') are also unchecked.
findings.suggested_fix: Collapse digit groups joined by a space, NBSP or U+202F (\d{1,3}(?:[ \u00a0\u202f]\d{3})+) before extraction and add regression cases; document that number words are outside the lexical check.
findings.title: Space-grouped thousands defeat the number check: claim '2 000 000' is supported by source '2 000'

findings.evidence: _assist_ask calls adapter.screenshot(target_id) (bridge.py:190) before VisionGate.build checks qualified (False by default), debounce and brain_idle, so a screen capture happens even when vision is disabled, debounced or the slot is busy, and is then thrown away. Latent: no adapter exists in this build.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a VisionGate.precheck() (qualified, client, loopback, debounce, brain_idle) and call it before adapter.screenshot().
findings.title: assist_ask captures the screenshot before the vision gate's qualified/debounce/Brain-busy checks

findings.evidence: revoke() clears lastObservation synchronously, but ask()'s continuation then sets lastObservation (and askId) from the ask reply, which the serialized worker sends before the revoke reply. grant() clears only askId/answer, not lastObservation/findings, so after Share the Live tab shows 'Read "<old title>" ...' from the revoked grant. Stop is enabled while busy (assist_scope_line.dart:52), so the path is reachable. Found by reading the code; no Flutter test was run for it.
findings.suggested_fix: Clear lastObservation and findings in grant(), and ignore an ask reply that arrives after a revoke (generation counter in the controller).
findings.title: Stop while an Ask is in flight leaves the revoked scope's observation summary, which shows again after the next Share
